project_experience_struct.title: 高级产品经理
project_experience_struct.description_en: In the realm of asset circulation and management, PayMight has built a closed-loop service system through three core functions: First, relying on the On/Off Ramp (deposit and withdrawal channel), it enables efficient two-way exchange between digital currencies and cryptocurrencies, seamlessly connecting digital assets with traditional payment scenarios; Second, via the Earn (wealth management function), it provides users with a variety of cryptocurrency wealth management options to facilitate the steady appreciation of assets; Third, by virtue of the Visa card, it allows users to conveniently use digital assets for daily consumption, further expanding the application scenarios of digital assets and fully covering users' 'exchange - wealth management - consumption' needs.
project_experience_struct.description: 在资产流通和管理领域，PayMight通过三个核心功能构建了一个闭环服务系统：首先，依靠On/Off Ramp（存取款通道），实现数字货币与加密货币之间的高效双向兑换，顺畅连接数字资产与传统支付场景；其次，通过Earn（财富管理功能），为用户提供多种加密货币财富管理选项，促进资产的稳步增值；第三，凭借Visa卡，用户可以方便地使用数字资产进行日常消费，进一步扩展数字资产的应用场景，全面覆盖用户的“兑换 - 财富管理 - 消费”需求。
